title: Business With A Mission
author: YWAM SF Communications
excerpt: Business With A Mission is a great opportunity to reach out to this generation. The job we do, the people we meet, and our quality of life are influenced by business.
body:
Business With A Mission is a great opportunity to reach out to this generation. The job we do, the people we meet, and our quality of life are influenced by business. It is a part of life that can impact nations, people, and societies differently. God commissioned His people to go into all the world and bring His kingdom. Using business is one way of transforming nations, especially the marginalized and unreached.

Many parts of the world still have not heard the gospel and will not hear it unless someone goes and tells them. The world is now open to business, with business people welcome almost everywhere. Business With A Mission brings the kingdom of God into unreached areas through profitable business.

Many Christian business people feel called to use their business skills and talents to serve God. They wonder how they may be used to bring transformation to the neediest parts of the world. BWAM provides a pathway where business people can use their skills and experience to mentor, coach, and encourage others.

Apply today for our upcoming SOTB at YWAM San Francisco.
